description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink messaging, including message parameters, frame parsing, and socket communication, specifically for Linux systems within the Thunder project.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class for Netlink message handling, providing serialization, deserialization, and message parameter management.

classes.name: Netlink::Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Netlink::Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames within a received data buffer.

classes.name: Netlink::ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message parsing.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Derived class for socket communication over Netlink, managing message sending, receiving, and state.

classes.name: SocketNetlink::Message
classes.description: Inner class managing individual message state, serialization, deserialization, and synchronization.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Netlink object into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink object.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket, optionally waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response.
